text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

1. Reps got back about five hours a week. Less typing after calls meant more time for prep and follow-up.

2. CRM data got better. Next steps and decision-makers were actually logged, not remembered "later."

3. Adoption hinged on trust. Reps asked first: who sees these notes? Clear answers beat any training session.

4. Customers rarely objected when we asked consent upfront. Surprise was the real risk, not the tool.

5. Summaries missed tone. A hesitant "yes" still needed a human ear.

The tool didn't replace judgment. It cleared space for it.

What would your team want to know before trying one?
